summary: MCP server 2: phase 0, guard header and bridge flags
author: pm
body:
Add `claude_testing.h` (DEF_CLAUDE_TESTING from _DEBUG, d-027) and parse `--agent-bridge-port=N` / `--no-agent-bridge` inside the guard; Linux passes full argv to GameMain (`wmain.cpp:84-86`). Default port 8891 (d-028). About 3 files, ~50 lines (derived). Detail: plan phase 0, `design.md`.

**Done when:** a Debug build parses the flags; a Release build launched with `--agent-bridge-port=8891` logs nothing, listens on nothing and has no `agent bridge` string; reviewed.

Source: plan `.claude/design/plans/client-agent-mcp.md` (HH-0033, reviewed 2026-11-24); decisions d-027, d-028.

**Closed, 2026-11-24:** read-only Opus review passed, with fixes applied (port range 8891-8898, #error on a hand define, malformed-flag warnings). Windows Debug, Windows Release and WSL Debug builds pass (measured). The Release exe has no bridge strings (measured, before the fixes; the fixes only add code under the Debug-only branch). A g++ parser test passed 10/10. The runtime half of the Release check (nothing listening) moves to HH-0037.
